entries.ai_hint_en: Round brown spots with concentric rings (target pattern) on older leaves first; leaves yellow and drop.
Water-soaked pale green patches on leaves turning brown-black quickly, white mould on the underside in humid weather, dark stem lesions, rotting tubers.
Eye- or spindle-shaped leaf lesions with grey centres and brown borders; nodes or the panicle neck may turn dark and break.
Many small oval brown spots on leaves, often with a yellow halo; discoloured, partly empty grains.
